transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I suppose I'm just... having some trouble focusing at work lately. I'm a loan officer, and... well, I'll just stare at a worksheet for a while. I keep rereading the same lines. And then I end up putting off client calls because... I don't know, even small decisions just feel too difficult right now.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with family and friends?

I suppose... yes. Most days there's just this... dull heaviness, I guess. Even if I go out to the community center, or... work in my garden. Those things used to lift me up, but... I don't know. Now it just feels like I'm going through the motions. Just... keeping a smile pasted on.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or found yourself feeling more fatigued lately, even after getting enough rest?

Yes. I guess... I do wake up tired, even after a full night. It just doesn't take much right now. Just... doing a couple of client calls, or going out to water the tomatoes. By then, my body just feels like I've put in a whole day already.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
I haven't really noticed any changes there. I just... eat what I usually do, I suppose. My clothes still fit the same.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A while, I suppose. Um... a little over two years. That's... well, that's when a close friend of mine passed away. It's just been like this since then.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt down and struggled with energy and focus, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
No, I don't... I don't think so. I think this is the first time.
Have you ever had any other times in your life where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble with energy and focus, even before the time your friend passed away?
Um... no. Like I just mentioned, I really don't think so. Before she passed... things were fine. Just normal, I guess.
Have you ever had any other times in your life where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble with energy and focus, even before the time your friend passed away?
I... I think I just answered that. No. I really haven't. It's just been the last two years.
Have you ever had any periods in your life before your friend passed away where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble with energy and focus?
I don't... I don't understand why you keep asking me the same thing. Like I just said, no. Nothing before that.
